title: Estimate of Periodic Orbits of Degenerate Hamiltonians
summary: The Arnold conjecture is a classic and important conjecture in the field of symplectic geometry, which describes the estimation of the number of periodic solutions of the Hamiltonian quantity on any symplectic manifold, which is equivalent to the symplectic version of Morse's theory.
